description.value:
The Art of the Libra Nunchaku.

Frequency once per turn

Requirements You are wielding both @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Libra Nunchaku (Right)] and @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Libra Nunchaku (Left)]

Trigger You hit a creature with a Nunchaku Strike

The chain whips back. Make a Strike with the other Nunchaku against that creature or one adjacent to it. This Strike is made at your current multiple attack penalty and increases it normally, and it always receives the twin bonus.

Greater (8th level) The free Strike no longer increases your multiple attack penalty (it still counts toward it afterward).

Perfect (14th level) The Art also triggers on a miss.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Libra — the Weapons]. Target the creature and use this; the rebound Strike is rolled and followed through to its damage for you.

Automation note: below 8th level the rebound is rolled at the second-attack penalty, because the Strike that triggered it was an attack. From 8th it is rolled outside the penalty entirely. The twin bonus is pf2e's own opt-in toggle on the damage dialog — switch it on, since this Strike always qualifies.
